# splunkctl soar

Splunk SOAR operations — platform reads, containers, playbooks.

## soar actions cancel

Cancel a running action.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl soar actions cancel [OPTIONS] ACTION_RUN_ID
```

## soar actions list

List action runs (optionally scoped to a container).

```text
splunkctl soar actions list [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--container` | integer | - | Container id to scope results. |
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Page size. |
| `--offset` | integer range | - | Row offset; requires --limit and must be a multiple of it. |

## soar actions results

Get per-asset detail (app_runs) for an action run.

```text
splunkctl soar actions results [OPTIONS] ACTION_RUN_ID
```

## soar actions run

Run an action on one or more assets within a container.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl soar actions run [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--action` | text | - | Action name. [required] |
| `--asset` | text | - | Asset name (repeatable). [required] |
| `--app` | integer | - | Explicit app id (skips asset lookup). |
| `--container` | integer | - | Container id. [required] |
| `--param` | text | - | Action parameter key=value (repeatable). |
| `--type` | text | investigate | Action type (default: investigate). |
| `--name` | text | - | Run name (defaults to action name). |
| `--wait` | flag | false | Poll until the action completes. |
| `--timeout` | integer | 300 | Wait timeout in seconds (default: 300). |

## soar actions status

Get status of an action run.

```text
splunkctl soar actions status [OPTIONS] ACTION_RUN_ID
```

## soar assets test

Test asset connectivity. Posts to /rest/asset/<id>/test then polls.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl soar assets test [OPTIONS] ASSET_ID
```

```text
The test runs asynchronously on the SOAR server. Results appear in
/rest/app_status and in the SOAR UI under the asset's configuration
page. If polling times out, the test may still complete on the server.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--timeout` | integer | 30 | Max seconds to poll for test result. |

## soar functions update

Update a custom function's Python source.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl soar functions update [OPTIONS] FUNCTION_ID
```

```text
Reads the new source from ``--python``, resolves the SCM repo id,
fetches the existing record, and posts only the changed fields
(python + commit_message + scm_id).
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--python` | path | - | Python source file to upload. [required] |
| `--message` | text | - | Commit message (required by SOAR SCM). [required] |

## soar ingest

Ingest SIEM search results into SOAR as containers and artifacts.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl soar ingest [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--spl` | text | - | SPL search to run on SIEM (mutually exclusive with --sid). |
| `--sid` | text | - | Existing SIEM search job SID to fetch results from. |
| `--label` | text | events | Container label (default: events). |
| `--severity` | text | - | Override SOAR severity. |
| `--sensitivity` | text | amber | Container sensitivity/TLP (default: amber). |
| `--sdi-field` | text | event_id | Row field for SDI (default: event_id, else row hash). |
| `--container-name` | text | - | Container name (literal or template). |
| `--container-name-field` | text | - | Row field to use as container name. |
| `--grouping` | flag | false | Group all rows into one container (default: one per row). |
| `--map` | text | - | CEF_KEY=SPLUNK_FIELD — map a result field onto a CEF key (repeatable). |
| `--map-file` | path | - | YAML file with custom CIM->CEF mappings. |
| `--include-unmapped` | flag | false | Pass unmapped fields through as custom CEF keys. |
| `--no-automation` | flag | false | Suppress playbook automation on all artifacts. |
| `--earliest` | text | - | SIEM search earliest time. |
| `--latest` | text | - | SIEM search latest time. |
| `--app` | text | - | SIEM app context for the search. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--out` | text | - | Output directory. |

## soar search

Search across SOAR objects (apps, containers, artifacts, ...).

```text
splunkctl soar search [OPTIONS] QUERY
```

```text
QUERY is a free-text search string. Results come from /rest/search
and may span multiple object types. Use --categories to restrict to
specific types (comma-separated, e.g. app,container).

Pagination is 1-based (unlike other SOAR endpoints). Without --page,
the server defaults to page 1.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--categories` | text | - | Comma-separated category filter (e.g. app,container,artifact). |
| `--page-size` | integer | - | Results per page. |
| `--page` | integer range | - | Page number (1-based; server default is 1). |

## soar users delete

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.


```text
SOAR DELETE sets is_active=False — the user is deactivated, not
```

```text

```

```text
This is NOT the usable token. The plaintext is shown once in the
SOAR UI at creation; REST only returns the hashed key and expiry.
```
